mechanism: Modafinil may antagonize the antihypertensive and sedative effects of guanfacine through sympathomimetic activity and CNS stimulation, while guanfacine may potentiate modafinil's cardiovascular effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely; guanfacine efficacy may be reduced; consider alternative stimulant or adjust guanfacine dosing if combination is necessary.
